title: 第7章 修罗场(2)
slug: 花千骨全本免费-花千骨最新章节列表
content_zh:
那是修炼者的元丹么？道行高，元丹未损的应该可以尸解，道行低的应该也可以再入轮回。不知道清虚道长又去了哪里
花千骨跪在坑前拜了两拜，天空突然下起雨来，洗去她一身的血污，空气依然凝重，但是花千骨觉得好受了很多，身上精力也变得无比充沛。
师父没拜上，也不是茅山弟子，可是却莫名其妙的做了茅山掌门，真是让人魂惊胆颤。花千骨取了那两本秘籍包好了揣在怀里，开始下山。
接下来的目标也很明确了，先去昆仑山的群仙宴上把茅山被屠，拴天链被夺的消息告诉给大家，并且把掌门之位传给清虚道长的徒弟叫云隐的，然后就求白子画白老前辈收自己做徒弟，最后跟着他回长留山好好修习。
有目标就有动力。花千骨下了茅山，问了去昆仑山的路途，一直向西，在路上行了两日。叫她惊奇的是晚上竟然都没有小鬼来骚扰她，也不知道是脖子上戴的异朽君给的天水滴的作用，还是轩辕朗给的勾玉的作用。只是一路看到的小妖小鬼越来越多了。连城里街上这种人多的地方，都不时有两只长得奇形怪状的东西在那飘来荡去。
周围的普通人都看不见，花千骨也早就学会无视它们，也不特明显的绕开了走。只是大白天的，偶尔一两只貌似很喜欢她气味的妖精会跳到她的肩上，让她觉得浑身起鸡皮疙瘩的，装作不经意的掸掉。
实在是觉得自己脏的不行了，穿过树林的时候发现一条清澈的小溪，便兴高采烈的跳了进去。顺着小溪，流过光滑的石头然后落进碧绿的潭水里。
她鱼儿一样欢快的游来游去，脱掉衣服，洗洗脏兮兮的头发和身体。觉得天水滴在胸前又微微发起热来，最近总时不时的发光发烫让她觉得很奇怪，可是也没觉得有什么不适，所以仍然还是一直戴在身上。
从水里赤条条的跑出来，在太阳下面舒服的晒着，正准备给自己换身干净的衣裳。突然听见周围传来“啊！”的一声。
死了，竟然有人。她还以为这深山老林
花千骨连忙抱住衣服遮住小小的身体，见小溪旁有个书生样的人正背对着自己，应是在汲水喝时不小心看到了。
“对不起对不起……”那人连连道歉，语气慌张，“我没想到这里会有人……”
花千骨不说话飞快的穿上衣服，虽是男孩装扮，可是披散的头发，红彤彤的脸却很明显的可以看出她是个女孩子。
花千骨收拾好东西就准备离开，却没想到那个书生抓起一旁的书篓背在身上，也匆匆的赶了上来。
“子曰：非礼勿视，非礼勿听。我、我真的不是故意的……”
花千骨从没听过这么温柔好听的声音，忍不住回头看了他一眼。却见他样貌并不十分出众，可是气质非凡，一双凤目盈盈含笑，说不出的温柔亲切。安静优雅，尘埃不染，仅仅一眼望去，已叫人从头到脚神清气爽，每个毛孔都熨过似的舒适服帖。
“没关系……”花千骨有些出神，好半天才反应过来，继续飞快的埋头往前走着。
那人却大步的跟了上来，步伐有点踉跄，样子却有些呆笨。
“怎么能没关系呢？你的身子都被我看光了，我若是如此不负责任，岂非枉读圣贤。姑娘你姓什名谁家住何方？等我金榜高中回来就一定与你成亲！”
花千骨一头黑线，自己才十二岁，个头又小，根本就没发育，要胸没胸要屁股没屁股的，就一门板，就算被他看光了，又看到什么了啊？

“没事的，你当没看见过就行了，对不起这位公子我还急着赶路呢！”
“知之为知之不知为不知，我明明从头到脚，从前到后全部都看见了怎么能当作没看见呢？这不是自欺欺人么？姑娘你千万别担心，我说话算话，一定会娶你的！”
花千骨咬牙切齿，从树林里一路出来，这个迂腐书生都在那哇啦哇啦嘴不停的说着。还一个劲的引经据典，宣扬礼义仁孝，女子之德，把她给郁闷的。她都不在意，他在那瞎嚷嚷个什么啊！一开始完全被他的外表和好听的声音欺骗了嘛！
走到岔路口上花千骨实在忍受不下去了：“你不是要上京赶考么？我们道不同就此别过，后会有期！”

content_en:
Is that a practitioner’s Yuan Dan? Those with high Taoist qualities and intact Yuan Dan should be able to disintegrate, while those with low Taoist qualities should be able to re-enter reincarnation. I don’t know where Taoist Master Qingxu went.
Hua Qiangu knelt in front of the pit and worshiped twice. Suddenly it began to rain, washing away the blood all over her body. The air was still heavy, but Hua Qiangu felt much better and her energy became extremely abundant.
The master did not worship him, nor was he a disciple of Maoshan, but he became the head of Maoshan inexplicably, which is really frightening. Hua Qiangu took the two secret books, wrapped them in her arms, and started to go down the mountain.
The next goal is also very clear. First, go to the immortal banquet in Kunlun Mountain to tell everyone about the massacre of Maoshan and the seizure of the Heavenly Chain. He will also pass the position of master to Taoist Priest Qingxu’s disciple named Yunyin. Then he will ask Senior Bai Zihua Bai to accept him as his disciple, and finally follow him back to Changliu Mountain to practice hard.
Having goals brings motivation. Hua Qiangu came down from Maoshan Mountain and asked about the way to Kunlun Mountain. He walked westward for two days. What surprised her was that no kid came to harass her at night, and she didn't know whether it was the effect of the Tianshui drops given to her by the Emperor Yixuan around her neck, or the effect of the Magatama given by Xuanyuan Lang. It’s just that I saw more and more little monsters and ghosts along the way. Even in crowded places like the city streets, there are two strange-looking things floating around there from time to time.
The ordinary people around them couldn't see them, and Hua Qiangu had long since learned to ignore them and avoid them in an obvious way. It was just broad daylight, and occasionally one or two goblins who seemed to like her scent would jump on her shoulders, making her feel goosebumps all over her body, and she pretended to brush them off casually.
I really felt that I was extremely dirty. When I was walking through the woods, I found a clear stream and jumped into it happily. Follow the stream, flowing over smooth stones and then falling into the turquoise pool.
She swam around happily like a fish, took off her clothes, and washed her dirty hair and body. She felt that the drops of water on her chest made her feel slightly warm again. The glow and heat that kept coming from time to time made her feel very strange, but she didn't feel any discomfort, so she still wore it all the time.
He ran out of the water naked, basked comfortably in the sun, and was about to change into clean clothes. Suddenly I heard an "Ah!" sound coming from around me.
Someone is dead. She thought that this deep mountain and old forest
Hua Qiangu quickly hugged her clothes to cover her little body, and saw a scholar-like person beside the stream with his back to him. He must have accidentally seen it while fetching water to drink.
"I'm sorry, I'm sorry..." The man apologized again and again in a panic, "I didn't expect there would be anyone here..."
Hua Qiangu quickly put on her clothes without saying anything. Although she was dressed as a boy, her disheveled hair and red face clearly showed that she was a girl.
Hua Qiangu packed up her things and was about to leave, but she didn't expect that the scholar grabbed the book basket on the side and carried it on his back, and hurriedly caught up.
"The Master said: Do not look at what is inappropriate, and do not hear what is inappropriate. I, I really didn't mean it..."
Hua Qiangu had never heard such a gentle and pleasant voice, and couldn't help but look back at him. But I saw that his appearance was not very outstanding, but his temperament was extraordinary, his eyes were full of smiles, and he was indescribably gentle and kind. Quiet and elegant, spotless, just one glance makes you feel refreshed from head to toe, and every pore is as comfortable as ironing.
"It doesn't matter..." Hua Qiangu was in a trance. It took him a long time to realize what he was doing, and he continued to walk forward quickly.
But the man followed up with a long stride, his steps staggering a little, but his appearance was a little clumsy.
"How can it be okay? Your body has been exposed to me. If I am so irresponsible, wouldn't I be a sage in vain? Girl, what is your name and where do you live? When I come back from Jinbang High School, I will definitely get married to you!"
Hua Qiangu has a black line on her head, and she is only twelve years old, small in stature, not developed at all, with no breasts and no butt, just a door. Even if he saw everything, what would he see?
"It's okay, just pretend you haven't seen it. I'm sorry, young master, I'm still in a hurry!"
"You know what you know, but you don't know what you don't know. I clearly saw everything from head to toe, from front to back, how can I pretend I didn't see it? Isn't this self-deception? Girl, don't worry, I keep my word and I will definitely marry you!"
Hua Qiangu gritted his teeth and walked out of the woods. The pedantic scholar kept talking. He also kept quoting scriptures and preaching etiquette, justice, benevolence, filial piety, and women's virtues, which made her depressed. She didn't even care, what was he yelling about there? At first I was completely deceived by his appearance and nice voice!
When they reached the fork in the road, Hua Qiangu couldn't bear it any longer: "Aren't you going to Beijing to take the exam? Let's say goodbye and see you again later!"
